info.title: HoBo CI relay read API
info.description: What a HoBo CI relay keeps about one account: its runner order, route decisions, machines, runs and jobs, and the signal, job-time and usage reports computed from stored runs (ADR-0183). Generated from `READ_API_ROUTES` in `src/read-api.ts`; do not edit.

get.summary: The runner order a connected repository has committed, and the parser's sentence when it does not parse.
get.description: Needs the `policy:read` scope and answers only the token's account.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: The connected repository, `owner/name`.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: A git ref or commit; the default branch when absent.

problem.description: The parser's sentence when the committed order does not parse; `order` is then the default, which nothing walks.

400.description: A parameter is missing or malformed.

401.description: No account token, or one the relay does not know.

403.description: The token lacks the policy:read scope.

404.description: Not found, not this account's, or `not-stored-here` with the command that reads GitHub instead.

405.description: The read API answers GET only.

get.description: Needs the `policy:read` scope and answers only the token's account. A host that keeps no route journal answers 404 `not-stored-here` naming `hobo ci route`.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: One connected repository, `owner/name`; every connected repository when absent.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Epoch milliseconds; rows at or after it. Default: 90 days ago.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200. Default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next` value of the previous page.

next.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

403.description: The token lacks the policy:read scope.

405.description: The read API answers GET only.
